entities.summary: Michael Cory Harris is an American former professional football player who was a guard in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the UCLA Bruins. He was signed by the San Diego Chargers as an undrafted free agent on April 30, 2012. He was also a member of the Minnesota Vikings.
